Pinned from master (dc77827b36adc5c04ea063515de4173ce28dbf2c) via the
Rust cellular-automaton sources:

  crate/src/species.rs
  crate/src/lib.rs
  crate/src/utils.rs

Upstream is a React + webpack site. The live loop is a tiny JS loader
that fetches a hashed .module.wasm built from that crate, plus a WebGL
fluid / wind field, a Firebase gallery, Sentry, ads, and a service
worker. None of that ships here.

This port is a classic-script rewrite of the species tick (Empty, Wall,
Sand, Water, Gas, Cloner, Fire, Wood, Lava, Ice, Plant, Acid, Stone,
Dust, Mite, Oil, Rocket, Fungus, Seed). Grid is 180×120 (column-major
index = x*height+y, same as the crate). Wind / blow_wind and the fluid
sim are skipped; fire still rises randomly; dust / stone / ice skip the
pressure>120 branches.

What stays behind: rustc, wasm-pack, the hashed wasm payload, WebGL
fluid, Firebase, React, webpack, Sentry, ads, the service worker.
